messages.author: 2bcf02adf526a370
messages.subject: Help INLA graph
parts:
Hi, 

I had my code that worked until November but tried to run it again today and this is what I get, when I run this:

pois <- inla(
  n ~ 1 + f(ID, model="besag", graph=UG.adj) +
  f(ID2, model="iid"),
  data = fmd_outbreaks %>% mutate(ID2 = ID),
  family = "poisson",
  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
quantiles=c(0.025, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 0.975))


Warning: The graph for the model besag has 2 connected components!!! Model is revised accordingly.sh: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-x86_64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla: Permission denied
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

Can someone help me with this please? Not sure what happened because it used to work well, have had the same code for a while and it was ok.

Thanks,

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Help INLA graph
parts:
it seems like the inla-binary has wrong permissions. I don't know why.
can you do

install.packages("INLA",repos=c(getOption("repos"),
INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE)


and check again?

if that does not work, you can try from R with

system("chmod +x /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.3-
x86_64/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla")
